name: stack
title: Stack
description: Stacks children vertically with a token gap.

when: Laying out content top to bottom with even spacing.
Placing buttons, tags or short items in a row.

guidance.rule: Space with `space` (gap), never margins on the children.

builtIn: Follows the reading direction, so it flips in right-to-left languages.

genui.description: Vertical layout with a token gap between children.
